notes.title: DLC1 Patch Notes.
notes.content: Updated DLC1 Battle Engine & Fixed Related Bugs.

notes.title: Major Patch
notes.content:
Requires New Game, old save files will no longer work, check forum posts the details.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1810220/discussions/1/3316358999123904324/

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
I've modified normal mode & companion primary attacks which use timed combos,
you can now clearly see where the hit within the circle, anywhere green & you can
use any button now.

notes.title: Out of Early Access.
notes.content:
Early Access users have been freely upgraded to the full version of Act I.
It's free demo is no longer available to download, might upload one later.
This change has taken place 18 days early before newest version patch.

notes.title: Getting Ready To Launch Full Game.
notes.content:
Around next month the set price of the game will be adjusted.
$5 for base game & 5$ for each Main DLC & Replaced Demo.

notes.title: Fade-In Bug Patch.
notes.content: Fixed new bug from last patch.

notes.title: Minor Patch Update.
notes.content:
Patched Graphics Bug On Player Transfer Map.
Includes Updated Diving/Submarine Questline.

notes.title: Update Bug Notice.
notes.content:
Issue(Key Binding Menu) May Freeze Game.
Patched Key Binding Lock, Work In Progress.

notes.title: Update Patch
notes.content: Re-verify your game files for update.

notes.title: Summer Sale 50% Discount
notes.content:
Join the Discussion Forum, help add feedback to improve this game even further.
Look for News or other Updates & follow the development progress of milestones.

notes.title: Bug Patch
notes.content: This patch fix addresses the game crash during battle victory condition.

notes.title: Price change (12/22/2021) Adding Demo Soon.
notes.content:
This Base version of the game acts as a Dungeons Pack DLC.(Outdated)
Will be discounted half price to match expected price changes.(Outdated)
Those who already bought it will be upgraded to Director's Cut.(Outdated)
The current version will be changed one month after This Date.(Outdated)

notes.title: Free to Play Version Patch
notes.content: This will be the same version as DEMO free to play, dlcs which be made later on but for now enjoy what is within the beta.
